notes: Privacy notice drafted for POPIA and a legal page with company details, the charter operator disclaimer, a PAIA note and plain website terms. Both are drafts for the client's legal review before launch. Every company fact comes from the brief; unknown facts (address, Information Officer, retention periods, whether a PAIA manual is required) are stated as pending rather than invented. British English, no dashes as punctuation.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: How Flight Hour Solution (Pty) Ltd handles the personal information you give us through this website, under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Flight Hour Solution (Pty) Ltd, registration number 2026/294346/07, is a South African company and part of the Flight Hour Solution group. It is the responsible party for personal information collected on this site.
The Information Officer's name and contact details will be published here once the registration with the Information Regulator is complete. Until then, write to hello@flighthoursolution.com.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Only what you type into a form on this site. Every form asks for your name, your organisation and your email address, and gives you the option of a phone number.
Each door asks for the details that request needs, and nothing more.
bullets: Engines: the issue, engine type, aircraft type, owned or leased, timing, region and, if you choose, a serial number
Aircraft: buy, sell, dry lease or ACMI, the aircraft type or mission, budget or monthly rate, start date and term, base country and whether you act for an end buyer
Parts: part number, description, quantity, condition, release certificate needed, delivery airport, aircraft type and whether the aircraft is on ground
Charter: passengers or cargo, from, to, dates, one-way or return, passenger count or cargo weight, dimensions and dangerous goods, and date flexibility
Advisory: organisation type, project summary, stage and timeframe
Engine 360 early access: your role, fleet size and engine types
General enquiry: which door comes closest, and your message

sections.title: Why we collect it
paragraphs: To answer your request, prepare a quote or proposal, and follow up on it. For the Engine 360 list, to write to you when early access opens.
We do not sell personal information and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: The legal basis
paragraphs: You consent when you tick the box on a form. Answering your request is also in our legitimate interest and yours. You may withdraw consent at any time by writing to us; we will then stop processing your details unless the law requires us to keep them.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: Only with the people needed to answer your request: the operator who would fly a charter, the maintenance organisation or counterparty involved in an engine or aircraft matter, or a parts supplier.

Form submissions are delivered to our inboxes by an email delivery service acting as our operator under POPIA. Our email runs on the group's domain, which may mean your message is stored by the group's email provider outside South Africa. Where that is the case, the provider is bound by safeguards that meet POPIA's requirements.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: For as long as it takes to answer your request and, where a quote or a transaction follows, for as long as that matter and the law require. Retention periods will be set out here in detail after legal review.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under POPIA you may ask what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, object to processing, and withdraw your consent. Write to hello@flighthoursolution.com. You may also complain to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site sets no tracking or advertising cookies. It uses only what is needed to serve the pages. If analytics are added later, this notice will say so and explain your choices.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Pages and forms are served over an encrypted connection. Access to the inboxes that receive forms is limited to the people who handle each door.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: This notice is a draft for legal review before the site launches. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

legal.title: Legal
legal.intro: Company details, the charter operator disclaimer, access to information, and the terms on which this site is offered.

sections.title: Company details
paragraphs: Flight Hour Solution (Pty) Ltd is a private company registered in South Africa in 2026. It is part of the Flight Hour Solution group; the Swiss company's site is at flighthoursolution.com.
lines: Registered name: Flight Hour Solution (Pty) Ltd
Physical address: to be published before launch
Managing director: to be published before launch

sections.title: Charter operator disclaimer
paragraphs: Flight Hour Solution is not the operating airline. Flights are operated by licensed operators under their own Air Operator Certificates. Charter is subject to aircraft availability.
This statement appears on every charter page and on every charter quote.

sections.title: PAIA
paragraphs: Whether the Promotion of Access to Information Act requires a manual for this company is being confirmed. If it does, the manual will be published and linked here.

sections.title: Website terms
paragraphs: The pages on this site describe services and invite enquiries. They are not an offer. Every quote is given in writing, states its currency, and is subject to availability and to confirmation.
Aircraft, engines and parts are quoted in US dollars. Charter may be quoted in rand.

We take care to keep the site accurate and we do not make technical or commercial claims we cannot support. Where the site links to other sites, including the Swiss company's, those sites are the responsibility of their owners.
The name, logo and content of this site belong to Flight Hour Solution and may not be reused without permission.

sections.title: Accreditations
paragraphs: Approvals, accreditations, B-BBEE status and a CSD supplier number are published here only once they are held and confirmed.
